causal_diagnosis.finding: The pre-obstacle centerline remains consistent, but a shrinking observed contour horizon drops its association with the still-visible obstacle. The existing spatial obstacle adjustment disappears and the command changes sharply. This is not evidence of a physical branch switch.

change: Retain local normals and positions of actual observed outer-edge samples in reset-local memory.
Transport correspondence search locations by the exact four-tick own-action hull endpoint pose.
Observe each edge again in current pixels with unchanged road/grass/blocked checks. Add only novel successful observations to the reference contour, with unchanged width/local fitting rules.

Keep the safety geometry computation separate: temporal reference matches add no road support. No command averaging, new planner, additional control candidate, threshold change or unseen extrapolation.

public_checks.limitations: No recovery when the current contour bootstrap itself is absent; no universal registration or hidden-obstacle certificate.

cached_old45.history_field_provenance: Explicitly derived from saved prior actual image and own-action transform; not present in original checkpoint. This is a diagnostic reconstruction, not a reset-run admission claim.

first_failure_diagnosis.limits: Disabling correspondence at the failed input also fails admission, but this does not isolate earlier trajectory effects. The reset run also includes the prior velocity-time rebase fix; no isolated regression attribution or full measured-state feasibility certificate. Some lower-pedal trials pass their first force check and fail later.

resources.unmetered: Interpreter/import, plotting and administrative overhead; early public-fixture assertion failures and the missing plotting package occurred without model/native execution. Unsupported tight-view cases are now explicit rejection tests.

constraints.Agent_inputs: public pixels and own-action memory only

decision: Not promoted. One reset verification stopped at its first failure; no second native run. Preserve the current-edge correspondence fix as an input-model research change, without claiming improved native reach. Further work requires a new bounded causal diagnosis of call42 force evolution before more native execution.
